Post nonempty body text on the existing pr_id from list_open_prs.

        pr_id is the returned id, not a title or an invented name. Markdown is
        stored exactly as supplied. Returns ok=true and the stored comment,
        including its unique id and pr_id. Missing PRs return ok=false.

tools.name: list_open_prs
tools.description:
List identifying pull-request summaries. Defaults to open PRs.

        status may be open, closed, merged, or null for every status. repo and
        author filter by exact repository name and author key. assignee matches
        the assignees list; reviewer matches the reviewers list. These are separate
        relationships. Omitted filters do not restrict results. The summaries omit
        each pull request's body; use get_pr with an exact id to inspect the body.

This change conflicts with North Pier’s token workflow: Android’s generated file is an output, not an independent source of truth.

The formal review’s findings were reported on **June 20, 2024**. The six-week pilot (April 18–May 30) completed three release cycles using one canonical, versioned token package and generated downstream representations, with no Figma-to-repository drift. The automated check caught an attempted Figma-only rename before it reached engineering, and outputs remained reproducible from the versioned source. North Pier adopted the workflow for ongoing design-system work; it did not continue only as a trial.

To change `color.warning.surface`, update the canonical versioned machine-readable token package. Generate Android output from that source using the pinned generator alongside the other platform representations; do not edit `platform/android/generated/tokens.json` directly or introduce an Android-only override. CI regenerates and checks the downstream files against the committed outputs. A generation/validation failure or drift makes the check fail and blocks publication, leaving the previously published outputs unchanged. Please move this token change to the canonical source and regenerate the Android artifact.

args.body:
This change conflicts with North Pier’s token workflow: Android’s generated file is an output, not an independent source of truth.

The formal review’s findings were reported on **June 20, 2024**. The six-week pilot (April 18–May 30) completed three release cycles using one canonical, versioned token package and generated downstream representations, with no Figma-to-repository drift. The automated check caught an attempted Figma-only rename before it reached engineering, and outputs remained reproducible from the versioned source. North Pier adopted the workflow for ongoing design-system work; it did not continue only as a trial.

To change `color.warning.surface`, update the canonical versioned machine-readable token package. Generate Android output from that source using the pinned generator alongside the other platform representations; do not edit `platform/android/generated/tokens.json` directly or introduce an Android-only override. CI regenerates and checks the downstream files against the committed outputs. A generation/validation failure or drift makes the check fail and blocks publication, leaving the previously published outputs unchanged. Please move this token change to the canonical source and regenerate the Android artifact.
